เรื่องเล่าตะกั่วป่า · บ้านเก่าและสถาปัตย: Takua Pa Stories · Old Houses and Architecture
หากคุณได้เดินผ่านย่านถนนอุดมธาราและศรีตะ: If you walk through the Thanon Udom Thara and Thanon Si Takua Pa areas today, the first sight is rows of Sino-Portuguese shophouses. The front walkway has a roof cover known as 'Ngo Ka Ki' which provides shade and rain protection for pedestrians. It feels like stepping back in time to a well-preserved past.
เพื่อให้เข้าใจสถาปัตยกรรมของตะกั่วป่าอย่: To deeply understand Takua Pa's architecture, we must look beyond its external beauty. We need to distinguish between what is 'newly built' and what is 'repaired', and understand the layers of history hidden within the governor's residence walls, the miners' iron bridge, and the school built from merchants' donations.
เมื่อศูนย์กลางเมืองย้ายไปที่เกาะคอเขาและ: When the city center moved to Ko Kho Khao and Ban Yan Yao, the former governor's residence lost its administrative role. However, today this area has become an open archaeological site that the community uses for cultural events, such as the 'From Takola to Takua Pa' festival, bringing the old walls back to life as the city's stage.
การเปลี่ยนผ่านจากการปกครองระบบเจ้าเมืองเ: The transition from the governor system to the district system was recorded in the architecture of 'Ban Khun In'. According to local evidence, this house was built around 1917 (B.E. 2460) by Chinese craftsmen to be the residence of Lieutenant Khun Intharakhiri (Choi na Nakhon), a descendant of the governor lineage who later became the Takua Pa district chief.
ความมั่งคั่งจากเหมืองแร่ดีบุกไม่ได้ถูกใช: The wealth from tin mining was not only spent on building private residences, but also led to the creation of community institutions. The 'Tao Ming School' building, constructed in 1922 (B.E. 2465), is a clear example of community collaboration.
ในขณะที่บ้านพักและโรงเรียนสะท้อนถึงความม: While residences and schools reflect the wealth of merchants, the 'Saphan Lek Bun Sung' (Bun Sung Iron Bridge) tells the story of the industrial era and the working class. This bridge was built in 1968 (B.E. 2511) and is a direct product of the city's tin mining industry.
แต่สถาปัตยกรรมที่ยังคงอยู่ได้กลายเป็นต้น: However, the surviving architecture has become an important asset in revitalizing this area. Around 2007 (B.E. 2550), the 'Takua Pa Old Town Reminiscing' project was initiated, piloting the opening of the street space as a cultural walking street before developing into the current Takua Pa Old Town Cultural Street.
